title: Before the Pitch
lessons: ritual does not require a product
care can be simple and repeatable

text: Morning light finds the glass beside the sink.
It has no flavor name. It has been waiting anyway.
You are hungry, thirsty, late, and none of those facts are a personality.

choices.text: Fill the glass and drink it standing there.
Make something small and sit down to eat it.

text: Cold water. A clean glass. No before-and-after photo.
The first five minutes belong to nobody else.
